open_points.subject: activate_flow_version
open_points.text: - activate_flow_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise UnknownReferenceError for an unknown flow version; then prove it again with prove_version and raise RefusedError carrying the proof failure when it is not proven; then raise RefusedError when the actor is an agent and highest_effect_class is above read, even when that version is already active, keeping nothing.
open_points.other_text: - activate_flow_version: [BEHAVIOR] When the version already is its flow's latest activation it returns that FlowActivation and records nothing; otherwise it writes one ActivateFlowVersionChange through record_change with the proven highest_effect_class and activated_at from kernel_now, under the kernel actor when that class is read and under the given owner actor otherwise, which replaces the previous activation at once while started runs keep their pinned version.
open_points.question: For an agent activating an already-active version whose highest_effect_class is above read, must the function raise RefusedError or return the existing FlowActivation?
